messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for region us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T15:08:09Z. 5xx spike from edge gateway -> origin path. 5m error rate 12% (baseline 0.4%). logs: https://grafana.redwood/incoming/alerts/5412346789

marta (oncall-sre): On it. paging infra and runtime. starting triage — is this a deploy or config change?

raj (eng-infra): I don't see any deploys in the last 30m (CI shows no job triggers). checking LB health -> a subset of edgepool instances are failing healthchecks, looks like connection resets to backend.

lia (eng-runtime): Stack traces indicate timeout at proxy->gateway handoff. sample error: `upstream sent invalid response: 502 Bad Gateway`. Sequence: gateway TLS handshake sometimes drops after SYN-ACK. Could be conntrack or NAT exhaustion.

elaine (support): Customer-impact: a handful of quota-based customers are reporting timeouts for generation calls; Support ticket count doubled in last 10m. will start a quick status draft.

marta (oncall-sre): Quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n edge | grep usw2-edge` -> several edge pods restarting. running `curl -v https://usw2-gw01.redwood.internal/health` from control host to reproduce.

raj (eng-infra): Sharing probe:
```
$ curl -sv https://usw2-gw01.redwood.internal/health
* Connection #0 to host usw2-gw01.redwood.internal left intact
* Expire in 199999 ms for 4 (transfer 0x55c3e6f2c050)
* ALPN, offering h2
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1):
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Server hello (2):
* SSL connection using TLSv1.3 / TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: usw2-gw01.redwood.internal

< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< connection: close
{ "status": "error", "msg": "upstream reset during body" }
```

lia (eng-runtime): Thanks. I'm seeing a pattern: clients with long idle connections get reset when route table entry changes. suspecting a misroute rule in the new edge-router config that started being applied ~15m ago.

marta (oncall-sre): Can infra confirm whether an edge-router config push happened? raj?

raj (eng-infra): There was a partial config rollout to edge-router tier `usw2-edge-router-v2` at 15:00 UTC (automated canary). Canary percent = 10% and should have been confined to a set, but the canary lock failed and it hit additional nodes. I'm rolling the router config back now.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-87321 opened and paged marta, raj, lia. Incident severity: high.

marta (oncall-sre): Good call. rollback in flight. Lia, can we quickly enable fallback to the older route table so existing connections aren't reset?

lia (eng-runtime): Yes. Two quick options: 1) change nginx upstream weights to divert new traffic to eu-west-1 pool (fast, partial), 2) flip route table back to v1 (slower if we need control-plane ticket). I'll start with upstream weight adjustment to buy time.

raj (eng-infra): I'm draining the affected edge nodes to avoid more bad handoffs: `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain --delete-local-data` on pods tagged `usw2-edge-12*`. ETA 3m per node, doing in parallel 3 at a time.

lia (eng-runtime): Pushing weight change now: updating envoy weights via /admin endpoint on control-plane (rolling).
```
POST /admin/v1/route/update
{ "region":"us-west-2", "policy":"divert_to_eu_west", "percent": 25 }
```

lia (eng-runtime): Weight update accepted. New traffic split: us-west-2 75% / eu-west-1 25%. monitoring for error rate drop.

elaine (support): Notifying top 5 affected customers with a short note: we are aware of increased 5xx in us-west-2 and are mitigating; next update in 15 minutes.

marta (oncall-sre): Observability check: can someone post the rolling 1m error rate for the region after the divert?

lia (eng-runtime): Post-divert 1m error rate snapshot: pre-divert 12% -> 6% @ 60s after change, now trending 3.5% at 5m. latency p95 improved from 2100ms -> 900ms.

raj (eng-infra): Rollback status: router config rollback completed on canary nodes, full rollback in progress to revert the misapplied rule. Coordinator confirms no new config pushes pending.

marta (oncall-sre): Ok good. start gradual rehome of drained pods back once we see stable metrics. lia, can we also enable connection reuse throttle to reduce idle connection churn?

lia (eng-runtime): Enabling keepalive settings tunable on proxy layer: `keepalive_timeout=60s` -> decreasing timeouts, and enabling `reuse_connections=true`. Pushed via runtime flag, will take effect ~30s.

pagerduty-bot: Update: incident severity remains high while >1% customer errors persist. All hands on deck.

tom (product): Any customers with SLAs impacted that need higher-priority comms? Elaine, coordinate with account teams.

elaine (support): Yep. three enterprise customers showed >5% failure for 12m. I've escalated to account managers and sent interim comms.

marta (oncall-sre): We're seeing error rate stabilize under 1% for most endpoints; still watching model-generation endpoints with larger payloads. raj, lia, propose we keep divert in place for another 20m then slowly move traffic back once router rollback fully validated.

raj (eng-infra): Agreed. I'll keep drain/warm steps going and run a targeted canary for the fixed router rule on 5% of traffic before full reenable.

lia (eng-runtime): Running a validation script against warmed instances:
```
$ ./scripts/smoke_region.sh us-west-2
checking 50 sample requests -> 0 failures (all <800ms)
```

marta (oncall-sre): Nice. I'll start de-escalation steps in PD once we hit sustained <0.5% for 10m. Please capture all mitigation actions into the incident timeline for postmortem.

elaine (support): Status page update: `We’re investigating elevated error rates affecting US-West (us-west-2). We have mitigations in place and traffic is being temporarily routed to an alternate AZ while we finish fixes.` Posted at 15:35 UTC.

lia (eng-runtime): Confirming keepalive + reuse flags reduced connection resets. Router rule rollback validated against canary. preparing to shift 10% back to us-west-2 now.

marta (oncall-sre): Shift accepted. shifting 10% -> us-west-2. Monitoring 2m window for regression.

lia (eng-runtime): After shift: error rate bump? 0.9% -> holding -> stable at 0.4% after 3m.

raj (eng-infra): Full rollback completed at 15:50 UTC. edge nodes rehome in progress. no more config artifacts.

marta (oncall-sre): Great. I'll mark the incident as mitigated and start the postmortem capture. PD will still keep the incident open for now until RCA and comms ready.

elaine (support): I'll follow up with customers and share RCA draft when available.

tom (product): Thanks team — can we add an action item to gate router canaries behind a stronger lockstep check to prevent misapplication?

raj (eng-infra): +1. I'll file an engineering ticket to add quorum checks + automated rollback if more than X nodes unexpectedly get the new config.

lia (eng-runtime): Action items: 1) add monitoring alert for unusual canary spread, 2) add a circuit-breaker on upstream route changes, 3) doc runbook for keepalive tuning.

marta (oncall-sre): Closing notes: Mitigated by divert + rollback. Impact: partial regional degradation for ~40m, >5% errors for some customers for ~12m. Follow-ups filed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
notes: incident closed -> follow-up tickets created: INFRA-4512 (router canary quorum), RUNTIME-2763 (connection reuse doc), OPS-890 (postmortem writeup)
